body:
ASVS 4.0 - 3.5.1 verification requirement is:

`Verify the application does not treat OAuth and refresh tokens - on their own - as the presence of the subscriber and allows users to terminate trust relationships with linked applications.`

I suggest we could simplify the language for this verification requirement. The wording is a bit  confusing sometimes how it was presented. Basically, to simplify it would be `a user should be able to kill the token and its trust relationship with the linked service/applications. `

This is related to Pull Request #755.

comments.body: @jmanico what do you think about this?

title: [Clarification/For Discussion] Simplifying language for 3.5.1
